program='''def transform(grid):
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(result), len(result[0])
    divider_rows = [r for r in range(height) if len(set(result[r])) == 1]
    divider_cols = [c for c in range(width) if len({result[r][c] for r in range(height)}) == 1]
    for r in divider_rows:
        for c in range(width):
            result[r][c] = 2
    for c in divider_cols:
        for r in range(height):
            result[r][c] = 2
    return result
'''
